description: This file defines a custom view component 'SlidingTabLayout' that provides a tab indicator interface to be used with a ViewPager in Android. It manages tab creation, styling, and interaction, allowing customization of tab views and indicator colors.

classes.name: SlidingTabLayout
classes.description: A custom HorizontalScrollView subclass that manages a tab strip for a ViewPager, enabling customizable tabs and indicators.

classes.name: SlidingTabLayout.TabColorizer
classes.description: An interface for providing custom indicator and divider colors for tabs.

classes.name: SlidingTabStrip
classes.description: A nested class (not shown here) that handles drawing of the tab indicators and dividers.

methods.name: setViewPager
methods.description: Associates a ViewPager with the tab layout and populates tabs accordingly.

methods.name: setCustomTabView
methods.description: Sets a custom layout for tab views.

methods.name: setSelectedIndicatorColors
methods.description: Sets the colors used to indicate the selected tab.

methods.name: setDividerColors
methods.description: Sets the colors of the divider lines between tabs.

methods.name: createDefaultTabView
methods.description: Creates a default TextView used as a tab, with styling applied.

methods.name: populateTabStrip
methods.description: Creates tab views for each page in the ViewPager and adds them to the tab strip.
